title: Comprehensive analysis of structural variants in breast cancer genomes using single-molecule sequencing
key_finding: Single-molecule sequencing improved reconstruction of complex somatic rearrangements in breast cancer genomes.

title: Long-read sequencing of 3,622 Icelanders provides insight into the role of structural variants in human diseases and other traits
key_finding: Population-scale long-read sequencing linked SV discovery to trait and disease association analyses.

title: A benchmark of structural variation detection by long reads through a realistic simulated model
key_finding: Realistic simulation highlighted caller-specific trade-offs across SV classes and sequencing settings.

title: Ongoing chromothripsis underpins osteosarcoma genome complexity and clonal evolution
key_finding: Chromothripsis was shown to be an active process shaping genome complexity and clonal diversification.

title: Benchmark and Evaluation for Somatic Structural Variants Detection with Long-read Sequencing Data
key_finding: Recent somatic SV benchmarking emphasized the difficulty of maintaining both sensitivity and breakpoint accuracy.

title: SVIM: structural variant identification using mapped long reads
key_finding: SVIM demonstrated strong performance for long-read mapped evidence across multiple SV types.

title: Long-read-based human genomic structural variation detection with cuteSV
key_finding: cuteSV provided efficient long-read SV detection with competitive accuracy and low memory usage.

title: MetaSVs: A pipeline combining long and short reads for analysis and visualization of structural variants in metagenomes
key_finding: Hybrid long/short-read integration improved interpretability and support for structurally complex events.

title: Challenges in structural variant calling in low-complexity regions
key_finding: Low-complexity and repetitive regions remained major sources of false positives and breakpoint uncertainty.

title: Accurate detection of complex structural variations using single-molecule sequencing
key_finding: Single-molecule sequencing improved sensitivity for complex SVs and clarified split-read signatures.

title: Extrachromosomal circular DNA drives dynamic genome plasticity: emerging roles in disease progression and clinical potential
key_finding: ecDNA reviews highlight amplification signatures, circular read evidence, and clinical implications of extrachromosomal structures.

title: Detection of mosaic and population-level structural variants with Sniffles2
key_finding: Sniffles2 scaled long-read SV detection to mosaic and population-level analyses with improved practical throughput.

title: NanoVar: accurate characterization of patients’ genomic structural variants using low-depth nanopore sequencing
key_finding: NanoVar showed that even lower-depth nanopore data can recover clinically meaningful SVs with tailored filtering.

title: Parliament2: Accurate structural variant calling at scale
key_finding: Ensemble integration can improve SV calling robustness, especially when different evidence types are complementary.
